app.notes: New: Gonka Host Monitor/Vote. See your own nodes next to every host on the network, the network as a whole (GPUs, rewards, GNK price, GNK in existence, the community pool) and every proposal, with how your nodes voted. A simpler home screen with the two things the app does: set up a node, and watch nodes and vote. Use Gonka is gone: the app is now about running a node. Ready for Gonka's next version, v0.2.17, now on Gonka's test network: when the network stops registering new hosts for them, the app signs the registration with your wallet (about 0.0002 GNK), and on servers with an NVIDIA driver older than 580 it picks the ML node image Gonka names for them.
